svg.aria-label: One part of the compute deal, settle, zoomed in: its two previews, one advance, and measurement
svg.text: Settle, zoomed in: the stage discipline inside one part of the deal
the storefront's admin API answers that
settle would submit and names the host it
would place; nothing is read from chain or written
in a mock lane, the provisioning test API confirms
the params, the host, and that the armed mock
rule would match and pause; no job is created
the buyer settles the escrow through the
negotiation: one call, one side effect
settle answers status provisioning and the
reads the escrow uid, the listing and
negotiation ids, and the passed preflight
the Deliver part reads the fulfillment id
